Detailed Description

A UGenInternal which allows repatching.

This allows its source UGen to be changed after construction optionally with a crossfade.

void PlugUGenInternal::processBlock ( bool &  shouldDelete,
const unsigned int  blockID,
const int  channel 
) throw () [virtual]

Process a block of samples for this blockID and channel.

This is the main rendering function and needs to be implement by all subclasses.

Parameters:
shouldDelete A UGen graph can be scheduled for deletion by setting this to true on return. If it is already true it should NOT be set to false.
blockID This is a sample counter, you can assume that calls to this function will have blockIDs which are higher that the last call (until the maximum integer is reached).
channel The channel index to process.

bool PlugUGenInternal::setSource ( UGen const &  source,
const bool  releasePreviousSources = false,
const float  fadeTime = 0.f 
) [virtual]

Change the source of the Plug.

Be careful when calling this from a separate thread from the audio processing thread and use locks appropriately. Previous sources are retained by default so that their processing still continues should the Plug be switched back to a previous source in the future. This means (for example) a soundfile playing back will not start where it had reach just before the source was switched but will start where it would have reached had it continued to play.

Parameters:
source The new source.
releasePreviousSources Whether to retain previous sources and continue to force them to process.
fadeTime Time in seconds to crossfade to the new source.
